notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.content:
Sorry for the late post guys. I had been sick for the past few days and couldn't get too much work done, or get active on the discussions. My health is getting better so expect the update very soon.

Here's a run down of whats coming in Update 2.0 (Single Player):
-New Map (City)
-New Car (Huracan Spyder-first convertible in the game)
-Improved drifting mechanics
-Improved force feedback when steering
-Ability to get out of the car and walk around
-Pedestrians and Traffic system
-Cops 

Update 2.1 will add improve the cops even further, with further improvements in the driving system. 2.1 will also feature full nonvr compatibility, along with wheel support (partial) and perhaps a 3rd person pov even in VR (suggestd by Craig). Expect a gameplay video of current progress of Update 2.0 in a few days. Update 2.2 will allow the players to play as Cops and bust racers.

Thank you all for your continuous support. As a token of appreciation, all users that purchase the game on or before August 10 will receive an exclusive car (McLaren 720s) which will be rewarded with the release of Update 2.0.

notes.title: Single Player AI Update
notes.content: New update with Single Player Bots is live. Play against computer for practice. This is just a test run. Will be doing a new update in a couple of days and modifying the current car unlocking system, along with progressive campaign-type of layout with the AI. Try it as is while you can! The new update also fixed the car not spawning bug, and car reset system for freeroam was also reworked/revamped and now resets your car closer to (location wise) where you pressed reset.

notes.title: Update on Progress
notes.content:
First of all, I hope everyone had a fun 4th of July!

There are a couple of know bugs remaining in the game. They are being tackled (actually, most are already fixed). Will be rolling out an update in a day or two. Second, I'm also currently focusing on integrating AI (bots) so users have something engaging and someone to play against if there are no actual players online. Will roll out an update with bots (perhaps in a week or so) and from there, I will start working on a full fledged campaign with progress and something to achieve. Of course, with campaign will come new cars and new tracks. Along with that, I'll also be rolling out some additional activities to do while in freeroam. Will release info on that in the next News Post. Stay tuned as I have a couple of other stuff to annouce very soon as well. And as always, thank you for your support! And remember to check the Youtube channel for sneak peaks on WIP stuff and join the Discord channel if you haven't already to chat with other VR Racing players. Any questions? Email me or post your comments/questions here and I'll respond within a day (maybe a couple hours depending on your timezone).

notes.title: New Update Live
notes.content: 4th of July Update is live. A couple other bug fixes are also included in the update.

notes.title: New Update
notes.content: A new update has been just released fixing the bug of car not spawning at random times. The udpate also disabled the "invisible boundaries" meaning now you can, once more, move around freely all over the map. There are a couple of other bug fixes coming along in the next update.

notes.title: Update on Game
notes.content:
For Fourth of July, I want to do something special. There's already a new patriotic skin (US Flag) in the game for Mustang; purchase the game on or before 4th of July to claim the skin! More coming soon.

Currently, full freeroam is disabled (players are unable to go on the grassfields) which breaks full immersion and realism. The reason I had done that was because some people complained about seeing grass inside the car when on the fields. Because of teh complaints, I completely disabled being able to go on grass until I fixed the issue of seeing grass in cars. I will be releasing an update very soon opening the grassfields, with the fix for issue of being able to see grass inside car. Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: WMR Update
notes.content:
I have been devoting all of my time and working for the past couple of days on fixing wmr. The reason for wmr issues is that wmr controllers don't support steamvr skeletal input, so having to redo the whole interaction system (which is extremely time consuming hence the long time its taking to fix).

Don't worry, I had not abandoned wmr. It's just I had been working literally all day to fix wmr for past days and couldn't be active on the Discussions either.

Because all my time had been consumed on fixing wmr, I could not work on other updates or adding new content which might experience a few days delay as well.

And remember guys, if you have any questions or need help, please message me on Discord or email me or ask for help here. I will always respond in a timely manner!

notes.title: WMR Update
notes.content: Still working on the fix for WMR,  Very close to it. Will be updating the game in a day or two with the fix. Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: Update on Game .
notes.content:
To begin with, we have hit 100 downloads!!!! YAYYY!!!! 😍Super excited. It doesn't seem much but it's a beginning. Thank you all for your support. Lets get on the road to 1000!! Lets make it happen guys.   

Secondly, there have been several updates rolled out with fixes of some concerns raised by the community. More updates are coming soon, especially the fix for WMR users. Stay tuned and thanks for your support

notes.title: Update on Release
notes.content:
I have been gong back and forth with Steam and Oculus Store. They have been holding back the game's release due to performance issues on lower end GPUs (VR's minimum requirement). But, a new build has been submitted since yesterday. I will update the status on that later when I hear back. So far it seems like I will be launching the game on Steam first, and Oculus Store will come afterwards.ːsteamsadː 

Meanwhile that was being dealt with, I started working on some new stuff for the game. I had been thinking about what type of things I could add in the game, and while playing GTA, it came to me that i should add Pedestrians in the game. I haven't worked on it yet, but I'm seriously considering populating the environment with people and more stuff to make the game more lively.  I'm also thinking of adding a character driver in the game so you are an actual character that can get in and out of cars and do car-meets online and more. What do you guys think of the idea?Let me know in the comments.

I did already start working on a new environment and new cars (Lambo Huracan, Porsche, etc). Check out the images in "Artwork" section of the community page and let me know what you think. During the run with the Beta Testers, I tested with 12 people instead of 6 for the freeroam which was pretty fun so I'm considering increasing the number permanently. Also messing around with Customization for cars at this point (very early stage). Add new rims, spoilers, bumpers, body kits, change color of car, new skins (camo, and more), etc. I will show off some of the new skins for the cars in a couple of days. What are your guys' thoughts on that? Do you guys like the new environment? Any car requests? Here are some pictures:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/10hp35X9ymjQbtpW1s9RCtsa22cXyknP9?usp=sharing

I have also started working on a mini-game mode involving karts! For the mini-mode, 6 players will race across the finish line in karts while fighting each other. Players will be able to pick-up power-ups on the environment. Power-ups will include boost, mini-gun, laser, missiles, and ram bar. You can destroy each other's karts to get ahead. The environment for the this mode will be a race track. Here are some pictures of the karts (these are not all the karts-only the ones that are finished so far): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1It667Bh5V540Xw6c-SmaHWAj7iKEzQaH
I will upload pictures for the environment very soon. You will be able to customize the karts as well. Will show off that as well very soon.


As I have earlier a couple times, I work full time and go to school full time so I get very minimal time to work on the game. To combat this, I have created a Patreon. If enough support is received on Patreon, I'll be able to quit my job and dedicate all that time towards developing the game. As an incentive, I have been thiking about how to support the backers on patreon. I have decided to give people instant access to the game as a reward for supporting on Patreon. You will receive a key for Steam for the game if you support the game on Patreon. an additional perk to Patreon backers will be that they will receive an exclusive car (Ford GT) which will be only available to patreon backers. Read the Patreon page for more info if you are interested. I will be posting some additional pictures and videos on Patreon to show off what's being worked on and what's already done. Here is the Patreon link: https://www.patreon.com/puregamez
I'm also working with another developer to do a combo bundle so anyone that pledges VR Racing on Patreon (a certain amount) will receive another VR game on Steam; still WIP.

Again, you can email me at puregamez14@gmail.com or join the game's Discord server and message me there: https://discordapp.com/invite/qTAKgRB

notes.title: Update on Release
notes.content:
I have completed some tests with the Beta Testers and chat seems to have some issues still, mostly for users from different regions. Working on getting that under control soon as possible. Sorry everyone, I know it's pretty frustrating since it's been over the planned date. It's just I have too many things to deal with (job, school, the game development, etc) solo so it's a bit time consuming. Don't worry though, trying my best to get it out within a week. Will show some chat tests with the Beta Testers soon.


I had been playing around with some other stuff, like NonVR capability for like controller and keyboard/wheel support (too many people asking were asking for it). It was just experimental, so it needs a lot of tuning. Going to finish off the VR part first, then perhaps roll out an update for other controllers' support. Check out the video though to see how the test went Video is on the game's Store page (second video).. 


I will also be posting some new screenshots and videos to showcase the final version of Freeroam.

notes.title: Update on Game
notes.content:
Hello my friends,

This is a quick update on the game. Sorry I'm writing this very late. I'm the sole dev for the game and it's kind of hard for me to manage the development and PR for the game. 


If you had followed on Discord, you might have read that the reason the release was delayed was because Gamesparks (the servers I'm using) just upadted their services and terms in February, which messed up the voice chat system I had integrated in the game. The voice chat was disconnecting randomly which as you can see is quite untasteful. But the good news is, the problem is completely fixed!! Now I'm just running a couple more tests with different people and different devices (including the Beta Testers) to make sure teh problem is completely solved. The game should be up very soon, mayble just a few days. Sorry for the inconvenience and HUGEEEE thanks for the support. 


Feel free to email me with any questions. Best way to contact me is Discord becaus I make sure to check that once a day and repsond to any questions.


By the way, I'll be uploading  new videos tomorrow (or so) with the latest features (updated Navigation system, more highlights on freeroam, showcase of chat, etc).
